author: m. s. manning
title: Pleasantville High School reports 10 Black students in 2025-26 enrollment
text:
Pleasantville High School enrolled 10 Black students during the 2025-26 school year, reflecting an 11.1% increase from the prior year, as reported by the New York State Education Department .
During the 2025-26 school year, Pleasantville High School had a total enrollment of 559 students. Black students represented 1.8% of all enrolled students, marking them as the school’s least populous ethnic group.
The school operates within the Pleasantville Union Free School District, which is based in Pleasantville.
At that time, Pleasantville High School had the largest enrollment of Black students compared to the other two schools in the district.
An evaluation by World Population Review stated that New York’s public education system was ranked second nationally overall , but it stood at 31st for K-12 performance.
